notes: Classification scheme for the Pax Silica gold record. The eval sample mirrors the gold schema (platform, decision_rating, confidence, content) plus a ground-truth label. decision_rating (0-100) = round(100 * P(anchor closeness)); confidence (0-100) = 100 * Laya's confidence signal. Only 'relevance' is scored.

relevance.instructions: Does this text discuss or relate to the Pax Silica initiative, semiconductor or AI data center infrastructure, critical minerals, or the Luzon Economic Corridor in the Philippines (including sites like Clark, New Clark City, or Tarlac and their local impacts on land, water, power, or displacement)? Text in any language counts, including Filipino, Tagalog, and Taglish.

labels.true: relevant to Pax Silica or its local sites

criteria.true: discusses, debates, supports, or opposes Pax Silica, AI data centres, clean energy, critical minerals, or land/water/displacement impacts in Clark or Tarlac
criteria.false: unrelated conversation, food, entertainment, generic Philippine politics, recipes, or general tech with no link to the project or its sites

deferred._comment: Not collected or scored. Kept here so the definitions are not lost if the analysis later needs them.

stance.instructions: If the text is about the Pax Silica project, what is the author's stance? News reporting is neutral; only attribute opposed/supportive when the author expresses it.

criteria.opposed: critical, worried, or against the project
criteria.neutral: factual reporting, ambiguous, no clear position, or not about the project
criteria.supportive: positive, optimistic, or in favour of the project
criteria.unclear: clearly about the project but the position cannot be told
